newsitem.title: UK: Pentland says pays 10 mln stg for Ellesse.
newsitem.headline: Pentland says pays 10 mln stg for Ellesse.

text.p: British sports and leisure group Pentland Group Plc said on Tuesday that it had paid 10 million stg for the Ellesse brand for North America from its former owner Ellesse USA Inc.
When Pentland acquired the Ellesse brand at the end of 1993, the North American and Japanese rights were excluded because these had already been sold to third parties.
The transaction will integrate the American rights with those for the rest of the world, excluding Japan, under Pentland's ownership.
Pentland said the trademarks and other intellectual property rights of Ellesse has been acquired by E. Acquisition Corp, which is a new unit.
Pentland said there would be no immediate impact on its profits from the transaction except for the loss of interest earnings on the consideration.
